h1: WaterColor "On the M.A.P." 138 Red Cedar Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 12 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Camp community of WaterColor- Walking distance to community pool- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 5 adult bikes - Low-Speed Vehicle- Xbox equipped with Game Pass, high-speed internet, Full home audio equipment, and 3 game centers. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Welcome to On the M.A.P.—the perfect home for discovering famous WaterColor. Sleeping 12, this 5-bedroom, 6-bathroom home boasts beautiful indoor-outdoor spaces, picturesque views, and ample entertainment. Nestled a short 3-minute stroll from Camp WaterColor’s community pool and relaxing lazy river, and a 5-minute bike ride from WaterColor Beach Club and the illustrious Gulf shore, this 2-story coastal haven offers a spectacular location for a laid-back 30A getaway.Mature oak trees and a charming front porch set the scene upon arrival, inviting guests to start each morning with a fragrant cup of coffee on the soft wicker seating beneath the gentle breeze of the ceiling fan. Step inside to find a well-appointed office and a game room boasting arcade machines on either side of the hall—the ultimate balance of work and play—before following the gleaming hardwood floors into the gourmet kitchen. The chef of the group will love the Wolf gas range and dual ovens, while guests who thrive on hosting will appreciate the wraparound breakfast bar seating 5 and a round dining table for 7. Rich wood beams, clerestory windows, and a decorative brick fireplace accentuate the living space’s soaring ceiling, creating a cozy and bright environment for gathering on the plush furnishings and watching TV. Take advantage of the Florida weather with a grill out the rear door and the sunny screened-in back porch, featuring cushioned patio furniture, ceiling fans, an 8-person table, and tranquil forest views. When the day winds to a close, sink into the guest bedroom’s comfy king bed for a restful night. This floor also offers a bunk room that is ideal for those with youthful spirits, offering 3 twin-over-twin beds, a TV, games, and a private bathroom.Retreat to the second-level loft, where a couch, armchairs, and an Xbox await unwinding. The primary bedroom promises elegant relaxation with a king bed, private bathroom, and screened-in balcony with ample space for morning stretches and coffee. The 2 guest bedrooms each feature a king bed and a private bathroom.Mark On the M.A.P. for a memorable WaterColor getaway. On-site parking and 5 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore. The nearest beach access is on Goldenrod Circle, past the WaterColor Inn, or at the WaterColor Beach Club.
